Thanks for the trace, Maya. I ran a quick reconciliation against our streaming meter for the session window you provided. Preliminary findings:

- The meter records tokens per chunk emitted by the model. If a client opens a new stream (new HTTP/WS connection) and resends the same prompt, those tokens are billed separately.
- In BR-6f2f8 we see a burst of ~7 reconnects for one producer between 2026-06-18T03:10Z and 03:14Z; each reconnect resulted in the model resuming and producing ~8–12 tokens per event. That explains ~60–80% of the variance for that session.
- Separately, we observed a small population of client requests that did not set the 'streaming_mode' header; by default the router falls back to chunked delivery that can produce additional framing tokens. We're preparing a backend patch to avoid double-counting framing tokens in cases where 'streaming_mode' is absent.

I attached the partial_trace.log and a short billing_calc.txt with the quick math. Based on the snapshot I recommend a provisional credit of €1,200 while we complete the full audit.

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: partial_trace.log, billing_calc.txt
